sentences.text: On 1.27, you can set `.spec.ordinals.start` to configure the start ordinal after enabling the `StatefulSetStartOrdinal` feature gate, and the feature is in beta.

citations.quote: You must enable the `StatefulSetStartOrdinal` feature gate to use this field

sentences.text: On 1.31, you can set `.spec.ordinals.start` to configure the start ordinal, and the feature is now stable.
In both releases, a StatefulSet pod’s ordinal is part of its unique, stable identity that persists across rescheduling.

citations.quote: StatefulSet Pods have a unique identity that consists of an ordinal, a stable network identity, and stable storage

sentences.text: In both releases, the default ordinal range starts at 0 and increments up to N‑1.

citations.quote: By default, pods will be assigned ordinals from 0 up through N-1
